vocabulary.meaning: an outbreak of disease that spreads across many countries or continents
examples: Pandemic is an important idea when discussing how pandemics end.
Learning about pandemic can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: the ability of the body to resist a particular infection
examples: People often have different views about immunity when discussing how pandemics end.
Understanding immunity can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: the use of a vaccine to develop protection against disease
examples: The topic of how pandemics end raises useful questions about vaccination.
We can discuss how vaccination affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: a disease that remains regularly present in a particular population or area
examples: Endemic disease can play an important role in debates about how pandemics end.
Different countries may deal with endemic disease in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: the process by which a disease spreads from one person or organism to another
examples: A discussion about how pandemics end can include the effects of transmission.
Knowing the meaning of transmission makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: the health of a population and organised efforts to protect it
examples: Public health is useful vocabulary for talking about how pandemics end.
We can use the idea of public health to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
